verdict.rationale: Snyk ships LLM-driven agentic features (the Remediation Agent), so acting as an MCP client is a fair question for this product. However, the evidence only shows Snyk providing its own MCP server for other coding agents to call, which is the server role and earns no credit here. Nothing documents Snyk itself connecting to or using tools from user-supplied MCP servers.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools
